findings.desc: packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:1193 checks full git status after the bounded metadata commit and throws before merging main into the story worktree. With any unrelated unstaged or untracked main-branch change, story_create --fromDraft commits the bounded metadata, then fails at this full-worktree cleanliness check, so the story/worktree have already been created but story/B-* does not receive the main metadata commit. This violates the bounded-staging/failure-behavior contract: either require a clean worktree before mutation, or only validate the bounded metadata paths and still merge main into the story branch while preserving unrelated user changes.
